issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing init_world(width, height) (two parameters), but the reference solution's init_world only handles a single parameter (it reads only width from the stack). This mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about the expected function signature and behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Either update the solution's init_world to accept and handle both parameters (e.g., read width from [esp+4] and height from [esp+8] and initialize both dimensions), and add a corresponding stub in the template; or change the problem statement to require only a single parameter if that was intended. Ensure template, problem text, and solution consistently document and implement the same init_world signature.
